build_google_genai_pipeline: build a Google GenAI manifold pipeline for Open-WebUI that generates text using Gemini models
create_pipeline_valves: create pipeline valves with GOOGLE_API_KEY, USE_PERMISSIVE_SAFETY, and GENERATE_IMAGE configuration options
run_pipe_function: run the pipe function to generate text content using a specified Google GenAI model and message history
test_stream_response: test the stream_response method that yields text chunks from a streamed Google GenAI content response
review_update_pipelines: review the update_pipelines method that fetches available Google GenAI models from the API
